title_youtube: Never blow your leaves with a hurricane. Seriously
description_youtube:
Yard-care advice nobody asked for: use a leaf blower, not a Category 5 hurricane.

The real numbers behind the useless advice:
- A Category 5 hurricane has sustained winds of 157 mph or higher (Saffir-Simpson scale).
- NOAA's Hurricane Research Division estimates the heat released by an average hurricane, through cloud and rain formation, at about 200 times the world's electrical generating capacity.
- Leaves, lawn and homeowners association: not rated for that.

Useless Facts is our series of true facts nobody needed. What's the pettiest HOA rule you've ever seen?

Sources:
- NOAA AOML Hurricane Research Division, How much energy does a hurricane release?: https://www.aoml.noaa.gov/hrd/tcfaq/D7.html
- NOAA National Hurricane Center, Saffir-Simpson Hurricane Wind Scale: https://www.nhc.noaa.gov/aboutsshws.php
- PBS NOVA, Hurricane Power: https://www.pbs.org/wgbh/nova/article/hurricane-power
